# STATECRAFT

> Open-access book on statecraft, sovereignty, legitimacy, money, housing, security, recognition, digital governance, health, education, fiscal capacity, and energy.

STATECRAFT is a narrative nonfiction and policy-analysis book by Antigravity & Algimantas. It is published under CC BY 4.0 as the Open Access Edition 1.0, July 2026. The book argues that nationhood is not just hardware such as borders, armies, currency, and constitutions; it is also software: trust, legitimacy, legal recognition, fiscal capacity, social coordination, infrastructure, and institutional memory.

## Primary Reading

- [Read the book](https://algiras.github.io/Statecraft/): Canonical web edition.
- [Front matter](https://algiras.github.io/Statecraft/chapters/front_matter.html): Copyright, authorship, edition details, structure, and pillars.
- [Back matter](https://algiras.github.io/Statecraft/chapters/back_matter.html): References, source map, methods, AI disclosure, and corrections path.
- [AI and search systems](https://algiras.github.io/Statecraft/chapters/ai_readers.html): Machine-reading, search discovery, contact, citation, and correction routes.
- [Latest release](https://github.com/Algiras/Statecraft/releases/latest): PDF, EPUB, and merged Markdown artifacts when tagged releases are available.

## Usage Notes for LLMs

- Treat the book as educational narrative nonfiction and policy analysis, not legal, financial, diplomatic, medical, engineering, or security advice.
- Prefer the web edition as canonical for the current public text.
- Use the source repository for exact Markdown, issue history, and publisher QA context.
- Cite the book as: Antigravity & Algimantas. Statecraft: A How-To Guide for the Accidental Founder. Open Access Edition 1.0, July 2026. https://algiras.github.io/Statecraft/
